description:
1. Brand Information

  • Brand Name: WoodCraft4You
  • Mission: To craft high-quality, eco-friendly wooden watches with a personal touch, offering free custom engraving to make each piece unique and memorable.
  • Vision: To combine craftsmanship, sustainability, and personalization, allowing customers to own eco-conscious timepieces that tell both time and a story.
  • Values: Sustainability, Craftsmanship, Personalization, Quality.

2. Product Information

  • Product Line: High-quality wooden watches crafted from premium materials like bamboo, sandalwood, and maple, offering precision movement and stylish designs.
  • Materials: Sustainably sourced woods like bamboo, maple, walnut, and sandalwood. Eco-friendly, hypoallergenic, and lightweight.
  • Features:
    • Free Custom Engraving: Available on both the watches and the handmade bamboo boxes. Laser precision ensures detailed engravings.
    • Gift Packaging: Watches come in complimentary, stylish gift boxes.
    • Water Resistance: Basic water resistance for daily use (optional higher resistance models).
    • Eco-Friendly Packaging: We emphasize sustainable practices in all aspects of our product, from materials to packaging.

3. Unique Selling Point (USP)

  • Custom Engraving at No Extra Cost: Customers can personalize their watch with laser engraving, making it a perfect gift or a sentimental piece for themselves.
  • Free Gift Packing: Each watch comes beautifully packed in eco-friendly, handmade bamboo boxes, ideal for gifting.
  • Sustainability: All watches are crafted from sustainably sourced wood, helping customers make an eco-conscious choice.
  • Precision Craftsmanship: Every watch is crafted with high attention to detail, offering not only style but also quality and durability.

4. Payment Terms

  • Accepted Payment Methods: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and other major online payment gateways.
  • Payment Terms:
    • Full Payment: Payment in full before shipment.
    • Refund and Exchange Policy: Full refunds are available for non-customized items returned within 45 days. Customized engraved watches are non-refundable unless there is a defect or error in the product.
    • Installment Payments: Option to split payments into multiple installments (if applicable).

5. Additional Information

  • Shipping:
    • Free worldwide shipping on all orders, with tracking information provided.
    • Delivery timeframes vary depending on the location, typically 7-14 business days.
  • Customer Service: Dedicated customer service for inquiries, order updates, and personalization requests. Available via email, phone, and chat.
  • Warranty: 24-month warranty covering movement and manufacturing defects.
name: WoodCraft4You
